s:
Consider the following statements in respect of the first Kho Kho World Cup :
I. The event was held in Delhi, India.

III. Indian women beat Nepal with a score of 54-36 in the final to become the World Champion in women category.

x: The first Kho Kho World Cup was held from 13–19 January 2025 at the Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, New Delhi. In the men’s final, India defeated Nepal by a score of 54–36 to win the title. In the question, a score of 78–40 has been given for the men’s team; therefore, Statement II is factually incorrect. In the women’s final, India defeated Nepal by a score of 78–40 to win the World Cup. In the question, a score of 54–36 has been given for the women, which is actually the men’s final score.
